[b]Coldness.[/b]

[i]As he took a step out of the apartment complex, he felt the cold wind envelop him, and he shuddered. With tired steps, he wandered down the street ahead, and he let his gaze wander ahead to see a myriad of abandoned cars parked along the street. They weren't abandoned because they had no owner, but abandoned because there was no fuel for them. Not even looters or thieves bothered to touch them as they contained nothing of value, as most of the things of value had probably already been ripped out by their owners to be smelted and sold. 

He finally reached a crossing and pondered where to go next. He could turn left and aimlessly wander between the apartment complexes, turn right and head to the inner city, or he could go straight ahead and eventually reach the outskirts. He kept on going forward, and after some time, he finally began to reach the outskirts, which were as desolate as usual, empty buildings, strangely clean roads, and not a single person in sight. He shook his head and kept on walking, exhaling as he reminisced on times when these roads were at least alive with traffic.[/i]
